brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

requirements.requirement: Seven-cell honeycomb work surface (centre cell plus six surrounding cells)
requirements.evidence: Seven full hex bases placed: centre (0,0,0) and ring cells (1,0), (1,-1), (0,-1), (-1,0), (-1,1), (0,1) at level 0.
Seven full top covers (one per cell, slot full;top) fitted on all seven cells.

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge finished with caps
requirements.evidence: 18 caps fitted, one on each of the 18 perimeter edges of the flower (no open outer edge left uncapped).

finish.summary: Built a seven-cell flower of full hex bases at level 0, covered all seven on top, capped all 18 outer edges, and bolted all internal joints (joint bolts) so the ring no longer shows the loose-body warning. check_build: no rule issues, meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
